connector.name: Quotewise
connector.registryDescription: Semantic quote search with 600K quotes. Find quotes by meaning, verify attributions.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.quotewise.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the quotewise account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional API key for higher rate limits. Format: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Anonymous access provides 100 requests/hour.
